latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the delegate-task skill for OpenSpace integration.
- Enables task delegation to OpenSpace for coding, DevOps, web research, and desktop automation.
- Provides four tools: execute_task, search_skills, fix_skill, and upload_skill.
- Includes guidance on when to delegate, search, fix, or upload skills.
- Outlines best practices for sharing skill improvements with the cloud community.
